decisions.reason: The adjustable quarter-pallet display is a flexible core format that is cheap to keep, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises some doubt.
The pegboard-back display serves recurring hanging-product promotions on existing equipment, though its missing web presence suggests lower priority.
The standard quarter-pallet display is a staple retail format with steady brand demand and fits the core cardboard production.
The wooden pallet is outside the cardboard core and hit by high timber costs, but it still broadens the range for customers wanting sturdier displays.
Physical media sales keep shrinking and the product has disappeared from the website, so resources are better moved to core displays and new development.
